title: 第6章 目标清晰时，就是全力以赴的时刻。
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

似乎是头脑缜密的天赋起了效果，越到这种时候，司陇内心反而冷静下来。

她完全无视了对方的各种挑衅，和即将到来的虐杀。

现在回应对方，对她来说没有任何用处，只是多费口舌，拖延一点死亡时间而已。

现实世界中的她25岁，穿到这个世界来后还是同样的年纪，长相，甚至身高这些都没有变化。

看对方的模样应该是介于高三到大二之间。

因为目前可参考的对象太少，她只能先凭借自己来断定对方，应该也是同样的穿越逻辑。

正是叛逆且压力大的年纪。

并且对方看起来就是一个在现实生活中极其压抑，有些心理问题急需发泄的反社会型人格。

求他？商量？或是利益交换？她根本不考虑。

因为这些办法放在他身上都行不通，男生摆明了急需一场恶劣的虐杀来满足自己变态心理，以此泄愤。

此时稍微给到对方一丁点的反应，她相信都只会激发出他更变态的那一面。

所有的求饶或是低声下气的协商，都只会让对方更加变本加厉。

她明白，破局的关键不在于男生，而是这个将她困于寂静中的梦境世界。

正在她头脑飞速运转时，男生一把将匕首狠狠地扎进了她的大腿！

“嘶！”剧烈的痛楚使她忍不住发出了痛呼。

很快男生反手又迅速将深深没入的匕首拔出。

她死死地咬紧牙关，额头的汗珠不停地滴落，猛烈的疼痛使得她身体控制不住地轻微颤抖着。

这他*的！真的是死变态啊！

司陇真是快要忍不住对男生破口大骂了，她再怎么拥有头脑缜密的天赋，在剧烈的身体疼痛之下，也很难集中精力想东西。

而永夜局的人到现在都没发现她出事，除非是整个大楼都被他屏蔽了，或者就是......他们不在同一个空间内？

对方也真是嚣张至极，在永夜局的大本营里，在自己的办公室中，竟然还能被掣肘成这样......

忽然，她脑海中浮现出周世通在办公室里，最后对她说的话，“您有事可以让人工智能深眠叫我，我会随时过来。”

深眠，如果她没记错的话，小说和游戏里，一般这种都是在头脑中植入芯片，就可以随时随地与专属的人工智能对话。

但不知道此刻在这个所谓的梦境中，还能对话吗？

想到这忽然又有了希望。

她忍着剧痛，尝试着喊了一声。

“深眠？”

......

没有回应。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It seemed that his talent for a thoughtful mind had taken effect. At times like this, Si Long calmed down inside.

She completely ignored the other party's various provocations and the upcoming massacre.

Responding to the other party now would be of no use to her. It would just waste more words and delay her death.

In the real world, she is 25 years old. After traveling to this world, she is still the same age, her appearance, and even her height have not changed.

Judging from the appearance of the other party, he should be between a junior and sophomore year in high school.

Because there are too few objects for reference at present, she can only judge the other party by herself first, which should follow the same time-travel logic.

It’s that rebellious and stressful age.

And the other person seems to be an antisocial personality who is extremely depressed in real life and has some psychological problems that are in urgent need of venting.

Beg him?discuss?Or an exchange of benefits?She didn't think about it at all.

Because none of these methods worked on him, the boy made it clear that he urgently needed a vicious killing to satisfy his abnormal psychology and vent his anger.

If she gave him even the slightest reaction at this time, she believed it would only bring out his more perverted side.

All begging for mercy or groveling negotiations will only make the other party worse.

She understood that the key to breaking the situation was not the boy, but the dream world that trapped her in silence.

While her mind was racing, the boy plunged the dagger into her thigh!

"Hiss!" The severe pain made her cry out in pain.

Soon the boy quickly pulled out the deeply embedded dagger with his backhand.

She clenched her teeth tightly, beads of sweat dripping from her forehead, and the severe pain caused her body to tremble slightly uncontrollably.

Damn it!What a pervert!

Si Long couldn't help but yell at the boy. No matter how gifted she was with a thoughtful mind, it was difficult for her to concentrate on thinking under severe physical pain.

And no one from the Yongye Bureau has noticed that anything happened to her until now, unless the entire building has been blocked by him, or... they are not in the same space?

The other party is really arrogant. In the headquarters of Yongye Bureau, in his own office, he can still be restrained like this...

Suddenly, the last words Zhou Shitong said to her in the office appeared in her mind, "If you need anything, you can call me and I will come over at any time."

Deep sleep, if she remembered correctly, in novels and games, usually involves implanting a chip in the head, so that one can talk to a dedicated artificial intelligence anytime and anywhere.

But I wonder if we can still have a conversation in this so-called dream at this moment?

Thinking of this, I suddenly felt hope again.

She endured the severe pain and tried to shout.

"Deep sleep?"

...

No response.
